name: Cranberry Jelly
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: To one quart of cranberries add one scant cupful of water, and cook until the berries are tender
Remove from the fire and strain through a fine sieve
Return the juice to the saucepan, add two cupfuls of sugar, and cook just long enough to thoroughly melt the sugar
When cool, put in a mould and pack in ice for an hour, and serve in sherbet glasses

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. To one quart of cranberries add one scant cupful of water, and cook until the berries are tender
2. Remove from the fire and strain through a fine sieve
3. Return the juice to the saucepan, add two cupfuls of sugar, and cook just long enough to thoroughly melt the sugar
4. When cool, put in a mould and pack in ice for an hour, and serve in sherbet glasses
